people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place; for the Syrians are coming down there.”
translations.bsb: Then the man of God sent word to the king of Israel: “Be careful not to pass by this place, for the Arameans are going down there.”
translations.kjv: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
translations.asv: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are coming down.
